description: This file defines the BuzzShareAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing 'buzz shares' in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, deleting, and updating buzz shares, and uses traits for authentication and database interaction. It also includes detailed API documentation annotations using OpenAPI (Swagger).

classes.name: BuzzShareAPI
classes.description: API class for managing buzz shares, including creating, updating, and deleting buzz share posts, with integrated validation, transaction management, and API documentation support.

methods.description: Method intended to retrieve all buzz shares, currently not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for getAll method; currently not implemented.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new buzz share based on provided share ID and optional text.

methods.name: setBuzzShareText
methods.description: Sets the text content of a BuzzShare object from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the create method, requiring share ID and optional text.

methods.description: Deletes a buzz share by ID, with permission checks and transaction handling.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules required for delete method, validating the share ID.

methods.description: Method intended to retrieve a single buzz share, currently not implemented.

methods.description: Returns validation rules for getOne method; currently not implemented.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing buzz share or post, including validation, permission checks, and optional model mapping.

methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a buzz share, including optional text and model parameters.
